visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young man wearing glasses and large black over-ear headphones, dressed in a white button-up shirt over a black t-shirt. He sits in front of a silver laptop, gesturing with both hands while speaking. The setting is a brightly lit, minimalist studio or office with a white wall and a dark door frame. (2) A quick cut reveals a crowded office workspace where four other individuals are seated at a long wooden desk. They cheer enthusiastically with their arms raised in the air. Shelves in the background are filled with toys, figurines, and office supplies under warm, hanging wicker lamps. (3) A woman with long black hair, wearing a pink hoodie and a black surgical mask, looks directly into the camera, adjusting her posture. (4) The scene shifts back to the main character at his laptop, then to another woman in a black top who is also seated at the office desk. The editing is rapid, alternating between these characters as they interact. (5) The main character enthusiastically presents a large, red Domino's pizza box featuring snowflake and holiday patterns. He opens the top layer to reveal a seafood and beef pizza. Subsequent shots show various group members taking bites of the pizza with satisfied expressions. (6) Detailed close-ups show the second layer, a matcha-themed pizza with a green sauce center and white mochi toppings, and the third layer, a cheese-filled volcano platter surrounded by various fried snacks like nuggets and potato wedges. (7) The group moves to a low table on a rug, wearing festive reindeer ears and Santa hats. The main character demonstrates disassembling the outer box to fold it into two game dice. (8) The group plays a series of games determined by the dice, including a 'no-hands' pizza-eating challenge and the man singing while playing an acoustic guitar. (9) The atmosphere shifts as the coworkers stand up and leave through a door, handing off tasks to the main character. He is left sitting alone on the floor, surrounded by plush toys and the empty pizza boxes, looking awkward.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narration in Traditional Chinese, set against a fast-paced electronic pop background track with a driving beat. The narrator speaks with a bright, comedic tone. Suddenly, a group of people chants 'Party, Party' at a higher volume, creating a spike in vocal intensity. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs, followed by the percussive sound of typing on a keyboard. A female voice enters with a calm, corrective tone, and the narrator responds with a short, pitched-down 'Oh'. The BGM remains continuous and upbeat. (3) A loud cardboard thud and rustling sound mark the opening of the pizza box. The narrator's voice becomes hyper-excited, describing food with sharp pitch rises. The beat of the BGM is prominent, and occasional 'Ding' and 'Pop' sound effects emphasize each new food item revealed. (4) The audio transitions to a social gathering setting. The sound of dice rolling on a wooden surface is heard clearly. The group performs a rhythmic chant of '不用手' (no hands) that syncs perfectly with the BGM tempo. A brief snippet of acoustic guitar playing and a male voice singing in English ('I'm done hiding') is mixed in. (5) A heavy door creaks and slams shut, signifying the end of the social scene. The background music continues but the lively chatter fades into the distance. The footsteps of several people are audible before the narrator delivers a final energetic slogan, ending the video with a signature comic SFX.
